attribution.modifications: Converted the original Blender mesh, 16-bone weighted armature and authored clip to Y-up GLB. Preserved the original 2048px texture and authored emission. Normalized weight totals while retaining all seven native influences and relative ratios. Added compatible R1 motion with anatomical joint pivots and bind-relative scissor grips; source hierarchy and inverse binds remain native.

The creator separately permits game use. The credited inspiration is retained without asserting separate third-party clearance. Native Chrome qualification remains required before release.
